_comment: Travel-time model. speedKmh = average moving speed including stops, per time-of-day period. waitMin = expected wait to board (halved headway when a line publishes its interval). Edit freely: the planner reads this file at startup.

periods._comment: Local (Manila) time. Weekend overrides weekday periods all day.

jeepney.label: Jeepney
jeepney.boardingTip: Jeepneys can be flagged down along their route. Wait at the roadside (not at an intersection), raise your hand, and check the signboard on the front or the side.

bus.label: Bus
bus.boardingTip: Buses stop at designated loading/unloading bays and bus stops. Wait at the bay, check the route number and signboard.

carousel.label: EDSA Carousel
carousel.boardingTip: The EDSA Busway buses only stop at the busway stations - board at the station platform and pay on the bus.

uv.label: UV Express
uv.boardingTip: UV Express vans load at their terminal and leave when full. Join the queue at the terminal; some vans also take passengers on the way if there is a free seat.

train.label: Train (LRT/MRT)
train.boardingTip: Buy a single-journey ticket at the station or tap a Beep card at the gate, then follow the signs to the correct platform for your direction.

tricycle.label: Tricycle
tricycle.boardingTip: Tricycles wait at their TODA terminal, usually near barangay entrances, markets and main-road corners. They are not allowed on national highways.
